_what: The families the account's own rows keep (src/account/rows). Every row names its account. `value` is the record's JSON text; its shape is owned by the module named in `readers`.

schemas._what: The account's own rows that are not records: the computers rows (family `places`) that say which computers keep an account or pursuit and which may answer, and the account's own lists (its copy rule's rows and runs, and its limits row). The schema keeps its stored name `sign_in` so no stored row moves; sign-in itself is the Better Auth Workshop tool (Nov 13 2026).
